spob.text: “Look! The days are coming,” declares Yahweh, “when the one plowing will catch up with the one still harvesting, and the one treading grapes will catch up with the one already sowing seed. The mountains will drip with sweet wine, and all the hills will overflow.”

public_domain_references.bsb: “Behold, the days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when the plowman will overtake the reaper and the treader of grapes, the sower of seed. The mountains will drip with sweet wine, with which all the hills will flow.
public_domain_references.web: “Behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that the plowman shall overtake the reaper, and the one treading grapes him who sows seed; and sweet wine will drip from the mountains, and flow from the hills.
public_domain_references.asv: Behold, the days come, saith Jehovah, that the plowman shall overtake the reaper, and the treader of grapes him that soweth seed; and the mountains shall drop sweet wine, and all the hills shall melt.
public_domain_references.kjv: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that the plowman shall overtake the reaper, and the treader of grapes him that soweth seed; and the mountains shall drop sweet wine, and all the hills shall melt.
public_domain_references.brenton: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when the harvest shall overtake the vintage, and the grapes shall ripen at seedtime; and the mountains shall drop sweet wine, and all the hills shall be planted.

pob.text: I will restore the fortunes of my people Israel[a], and they will rebuild ruined cities and inhabit them; they will plant vineyards and drink their wine; they will make gardens and eat their fruit.

spob.text: I will restore the well-being of my people Israel.[a] They will rebuild the ruined cities and live in them. They will plant vineyards and drink the wine they produce. They will make gardens and eat the fruit they grow.

public_domain_references.bsb: I will restore My people Israel from captivity; they will rebuild and inhabit the ruined cities. They will plant vineyards and drink their wine; they will make gardens and eat their fruit.
public_domain_references.web: I will bring my people Israel back from captivity, and they will rebuild the ruined cities, and inhabit them; and they will plant vineyards, and drink wine from them. They shall also make gardens, and eat their fruit.
public_domain_references.asv: And I will bring back the captivity of my people Israel, and they shall build the waste cities, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and drink the wine thereof; they shall also make gardens, and eat the fruit of them.
public_domain_references.kjv: And I will bring again the captivity of my people of Israel, and they shall build the waste cities, and inhabit [them;] and they shall plant vineyards, and drink the wine thereof; they shall also make gardens, and eat the fruit of them.
public_domain_references.brenton: And I will turn the captivity of my people Israel, and they shall rebuild the ruined cities, and shall inhabit [them]; and they shall plant vineyards, and shall drink the wine from them; and they shall form gardens, and eat the fruit of them.

pob.text: I will plant them on their land[a], and they will never again be uprooted from the land that I have given them, says Yahweh your God.

spob.text: “I will plant them in their own land. They will never again be uprooted from the land I have given them,” says Yahweh your God.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: I will firmly plant them in their own land, never again to be uprooted from the land that I have given them,” says the LORD your God.
public_domain_references.web: I will plant them on their land, and they will no more be plucked up out of their land which I have given them,” says Yahweh your God.
public_domain_references.asv: And I will plant them upon their land, and they shall no more be plucked up out of their land which I have given them, saith Jehovah thy God.
public_domain_references.kjv: And I will plant them upon their land, and they shall no more be pulled up out of their land which I have given them, saith the LORD thy God.
public_domain_references.brenton: And I will plant them on their land, and they shall no more be plucked up from the land which I have given them, saith the Lord God Almighty.
